_comment: CPU/part-focused 2x training pool (v6). INHERITS v5_sharp scale/shape/PSF/noise/shift/defects/temperature VERBATIM; the ONLY change is the scene-content geometry: geometry.motif_weights selects CPU/electronic-part motifs (die & package outlines, fine regular pad grids = PGA/BGA/via lattices, routing/lead-frame buses, heat-spreader fins) instead of the legacy generic IC layout. This addresses the synthetic_data_realism.md open TODO ('真实是一个 die 上细密规则栅格/阵列, 合成偏粗大随机块 ... 可加一类细栅格/阵列母题'). All grid pitches stay > detector pitch (20um) so they remain recoverable (ACL-023 band honesty; NOT sub-pitch fantasy) — see _compose_cpu_scene bands in tcforge/geometry.py. Randomisation is scoped WITHIN the parts family (die size/count, pitch/extent/orientation, trace width/count, pad shape/drops/keep-out) with a 6% generic-block minority for diversity. Realism preserved from v5: isothermal-per-component temperature (edge_sigma 0.6), irregular defects, PSF sigma 0.15-0.55 + 2x physical_block_average, and the vignette+column-stripe+grain burst noise. Preview before committing.

physics_ranges._comment_delta_T: v6 CPU redesign: ΔT is a CONTINUOUS per-scene nuisance, NOT stepped by difficulty. delta_T_c_continuous = union min-max of the four legacy delta_T_c_by_difficulty ranges [0.3, 5.0]; when present, generate_training_pool samples ΔT from it and IGNORES difficulty. delta_T_c_by_difficulty retained only for schema/legacy compatibility.

_comment_difficulty: v6 CPU redesign: difficulty tiers are VESTIGIAL for this pool — CPU geometry uses a continuous `density` scalar (stored in geometry_metadata.density) and ΔT uses delta_T_c_continuous, neither gated by difficulty. Collapsed to a single bucket so the (still-threaded) difficulty label is uniform metadata.

detector_defects._note: disabled: real frames (min 18.67C) show no dead-pixel spikes; was injecting unrealistic <0C cold pixels
